translations.saheeh: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
translations.pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
translations.khattab: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—
translations.arberry: 'O My servants, today no fear is on you, neither do you sorrow' --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
translations.pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
translations.khattab: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of
translations.arberry: Then leave them alone to plunge and play, until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
translations.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
translations.khattab: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible
translations.arberry: So be on the watch for a day when heaven shall bring a manifest smoke

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

translations.saheeh: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
translations.pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
translations.khattab: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment
translations.arberry: Upon the day when We shall assault most mightily, then We shall take Our vengeance.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
translations.pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
translations.khattab: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—
translations.arberry: Surely the Day of Decision shall be their appointed time, all together,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.saheeh: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
translations.pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
translations.khattab: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped
translations.arberry: the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

translations.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
translations.pickthall: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
translations.khattab: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit
translations.arberry: Say unto those who believe, that they forgive those who do not look for the days of God, that He may recompense a people for that they have been earning.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

translations.saheeh: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
translations.pickthall: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
translations.khattab: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences
translations.arberry: We gave them clear signs of the Command; so they differed not, except after the knowledge had come to them, being insolent one to another. Surely thy Lord will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection touching their differences.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
translations.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
translations.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”
translations.arberry: Say: 'God gives you life, then makes you die, then He shall gather you to the Day of Resurrection, wherein is no doubt, but most men do not know.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
translations.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
translations.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss
translations.arberry: To God belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the day when the Hour is come, upon that day the vain-doers shall lose.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةࣲ جَاثِيَةࣰۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةࣲ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
translations.pickthall: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.
translations.khattab: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do
translations.arberry: And thou shalt see every nation hobbling on their knees, every nation being summoned unto its Book: 'Today you shall be recompensed for that you were doing.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

translations.saheeh: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
translations.pickthall: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
translations.khattab: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers
translations.arberry: And it shall be said, 'Today We do forget you, even as you forgot the encounter of this your day; and your refuge is the Fire, and you shall have no helpers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

translations.saheeh: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
translations.pickthall: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
translations.khattab: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers
translations.arberry: And it shall be said, 'Today We do forget you, even as you forgot the encounter of this your day; and your refuge is the Fire, and you shall have no helpers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوࣰ ا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ

translations.saheeh: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
translations.pickthall: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.
translations.khattab: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺
translations.arberry: That is for that you took God's signs in mockery, and the present life deluded you.' So today they shall not be brought forth from it, nor will they be suffered to make amends.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدۡعُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسۡتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمۡ عَن دُعَآئِهِمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ

translations.saheeh: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
translations.pickthall: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,
translations.khattab: And who could be more astray than those who call upon others besides Allah—˹others˺ that cannot respond to them until the Day of Judgment, and are ˹even˺ unaware of their calls
translations.arberry: And who is further astray than he who calls, apart from God, upon such a one as shall not answer him till the Day of Resurrection? Such as are heedless of their calling,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمۡ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُم بِهَا فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
translations.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress.
translations.khattab: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire. ˹They will be told,˺ “You ˹already˺ exhausted your ˹share of˺ pleasures during your worldly life, and ˹fully˺ enjoyed them. So Today you will be rewarded with the torment of disgrace for your arrogance throughout the land with no right, and for your rebelliousness.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the unbelievers are exposed to the Fire: 'You dissipated your good things in your present life, and you took your enjoyment in them; therefore today you shall be recompensed with the chastisement of humiliation for that you waxed proud in the earth without right, and for your ungodliness.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَذۡهَبۡتُمۡ طَيِّبَٰتِكُمۡ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱسۡتَمۡتَعۡتُم بِهَا فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَفۡسُقُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
translations.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress.
translations.khattab: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire. ˹They will be told,˺ “You ˹already˺ exhausted your ˹share of˺ pleasures during your worldly life, and ˹fully˺ enjoyed them. So Today you will be rewarded with the torment of disgrace for your arrogance throughout the land with no right, and for your rebelliousness.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the unbelievers are exposed to the Fire: 'You dissipated your good things in your present life, and you took your enjoyment in them; therefore today you shall be recompensed with the chastisement of humiliation for that you waxed proud in the earth without right, and for your ungodliness.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞وَٱذۡكُرۡ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذۡ أَنذَرَ قَوۡمَهُۥ بِٱلۡأَحۡقَافِ وَقَدۡ خَلَتِ ٱلنُّذُرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦٓ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
translations.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of the brother of A'ad when he warned his folk among the wind-curved sandhills - and verily warners came and went before and after him - saying: Serve none but Allah. Lo! I fear for you the doom of a tremendous Day.
translations.khattab: And remember the brother of ’Ȃd, when he warned his people, who inhabited the sand-hills—there were certainly warners before and after him—˹saying,˺ “Worship none but Allah. I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”
translations.arberry: And remember the brother of Ad, when he warned his people beside the sand-dunes -- and already warners had passed away alike before him and behind him -- saying, 'Serve none but God! Truly I fear for you the chastisement of a dreadful day.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
translations.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved.
translations.khattab: And on the Day the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire, ˹they will be asked,˺ “Is this ˹Hereafter˺ not the truth?” They will cry, “Absolutely, by our Lord!” It will be said, “Then taste the punishment for your disbelief.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the unbelievers are exposed to the Fire: 'Is not this the truth?' They shall say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He shall say, 'Then taste the chastisement of your unbelief!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡعَزۡمِ مِنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِل لَّهُمۡۚ كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا سَاعَةࣰ مِّن نَّهَارِۭۚ بَلَٰغࣱۚ فَهَلۡ يُهۡلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
translations.pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad) even as the stout of heart among the messengers (of old) had patience, and seek not to hasten on (the doom) for them. On the day when they see that which they are promised (it will seem to them) as though they had tarried but an hour of daylight. A clear message. Shall any be destroyed save evil-living folk?
translations.khattab: So endure patiently, as did the Messengers of Firm Resolve. And do not ˹seek to˺ hasten ˹the torment˺ for the deniers. On the Day they see what they have been threatened with, it will be as if they had only stayed ˹in this world˺ for an hour of a day. ˹This is˺ a ˹sufficient˺ warning! Then, will anyone be destroyed except the rebellious people
translations.arberry: So be thou patient, as the Messengers possessed of constancy were also patient. Seek not to hasten it for them -- it shall be as if on the day they see that they are promised, they had not tarried but for an hour of a single day. A Message to be delivered! And shall any be destroyed but the people of the ungodly?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ

translations.saheeh: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
translations.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
translations.khattab: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of
translations.arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; that is the Day of the Threat.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
translations.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
translations.khattab: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”
translations.arberry: 'Thou wast heedless of this; therefore We have now removed from thee thy covering, and so thy sight today is piercing.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
translations.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
translations.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”
translations.arberry: Upon the day We shall say unto Gehenna, 'Art thou filled?' And it shall say, 'Are there any more to come?'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ

translations.saheeh: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
translations.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
translations.khattab: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”
translations.arberry: 'Enter it in peace! This is the Day of Eternity.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
translations.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
translations.khattab: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
translations.arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
translations.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
translations.khattab: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place
translations.arberry: And listen thou for the day when the caller shall call from a near place.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ

translations.saheeh: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
translations.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
translations.khattab: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺
translations.arberry: On the day they hear the Cry in truth, that is the day of coming forth.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ

translations.saheeh: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
translations.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
translations.khattab: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺
translations.arberry: On the day they hear the Cry in truth, that is the day of coming forth.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
translations.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
translations.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the earth is split asunder from about them as they hasten forth; that is a mustering easy for Us.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
translations.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
translations.khattab: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
translations.arberry: asking, 'When shall be the Day of Doom?'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفۡتَنُونَ

translations.saheeh: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
translations.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
translations.arberry: Upon the day when they shall be tried at the Fire:

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
translations.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
translations.khattab: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of
translations.arberry: So woe to the unbelievers, for that day of theirs that they are promised.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
translations.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
translations.khattab: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently
translations.arberry: Upon the day when heaven spins dizzily

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

translations.saheeh: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
translations.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell
translations.arberry: the day when they shall be pitched into the fire of Gehenna:

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ

translations.saheeh: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
translations.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
translations.khattab: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
translations.arberry: Then leave them, till they encounter their day wherein they shall be thunderstruck,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.saheeh: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
translations.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
translations.khattab: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped
translations.arberry: the day when their guile shall avail them naught, and they shall not be helped.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ

translations.saheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
translations.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
translations.khattab: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
translations.arberry: So turn thou away from them. Upon the day when the Caller shall call unto a horrible thing,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
translations.pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
translations.khattab: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
translations.arberry: running with outstretched necks to the Caller. The unbelievers shall say, 'This is a hard day!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
translations.pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
translations.khattab: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
translations.arberry: We loosed against them a wind clamorous in a day of ill fortune continuous,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

translations.saheeh: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
translations.pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
translations.khattab: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
translations.arberry: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire: 'Taste now the touch of Sakar!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
translations.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
translations.khattab: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
translations.arberry: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth implore Him; every day He is upon some labour.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَمَجۡمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمࣲ مَّعۡلُومࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
translations.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
translations.khattab: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day
translations.arberry: shall be gathered to the appointed time of a known day.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
translations.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
translations.khattab: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment
translations.arberry: This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Doom.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِۖ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعۡرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: It is He that created the heavens and the earth in six days then seated Himself upon the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth, and what comes forth from it, -- what comes down from heaven, and what goes up unto it. He is with you wherever you are; and God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

translations.saheeh: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
translations.pickthall: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
translations.khattab: On that Day you will see believing men and women with their light shining ahead of them and on their right. ˹They will be told,˺ “Today you have good news of Gardens, under which rivers flow, ˹for you˺ to stay in forever. This is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when thou seest the believers, men and women, their light running before them, and on their right hands. 'Good tidings for you today! Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to dwell for ever; that is indeed the mighty triumph.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ يَسۡعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشۡرَىٰكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

translations.saheeh: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
translations.pickthall: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
translations.khattab: On that Day you will see believing men and women with their light shining ahead of them and on their right. ˹They will be told,˺ “Today you have good news of Gardens, under which rivers flow, ˹for you˺ to stay in forever. This is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when thou seest the believers, men and women, their light running before them, and on their right hands. 'Good tidings for you today! Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to dwell for ever; that is indeed the mighty triumph.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورࣰ اۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورࣲ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ

translations.saheeh: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
translations.pickthall: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
translations.khattab: On that Day hypocrite men and women will beg the believers, “Wait for us so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said ˹mockingly˺, “Go back ˹to the world˺ and seek a light ˹there˺!” Then a ˹separating˺ wall with a gate will be erected between them. On the near side will be grace and on the far side will be torment
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the hypocrites, men and women, shall say to those who have believed, 'Wait for us, so that we may borrow your light!' It shall be said, 'Return you back behind, and seek for a light!' And a wall shall be set up between them, having a door in the inward whereof is mercy, and against the outward thereof is chastisement.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنكُمۡ فِدۡيَةࣱ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ مَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُۖ هِيَ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
translations.pickthall: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.
translations.khattab: So Today no ransom will be accepted from you ˹hypocrites˺, nor from the disbelievers. Your home is the Fire—it is the ˹only˺ fitting place for you. What an evil destination!”
translations.arberry: Therefore today no ransom shall be taken from you, neither from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire, that is your master -- an evil homecoming!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعࣰ ا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ أَحۡصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ

translations.saheeh: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.
translations.pickthall: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things.
translations.khattab: On the Day Allah resurrects them all together, He will then inform them of what they have done. Allah has kept account of it all, while they have forgotten it. For Allah is a Witness over all things
translations.arberry: upon the day when God shall raise them up all together, then He shall tell them what they did.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجۡوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمۡ وَلَا خَمۡسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كَانُواْۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ

translations.saheeh: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.
translations.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.
translations.khattab: Do you not see that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? If three converse privately, He is their fourth. If five, He is their sixth. Whether fewer or more, He is with them wherever they may be. Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will inform them of what they have done. Surely Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things
translations.arberry: God has numbered it, and they have forgotten it. God is witness over everything. Hast thou not seen that God knows whatsoever is in the heavens, and whatsoever is in the earth? Three men conspire not secretly together, but He is the fourth of them, neither five men, but He is the sixth of them, neither fewer than that, neither more, but He is with them, wherever they may be; then He shall tell them what they have done, on the Day of Resurrection. Surely God has knowledge of everything.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعࣰ ا فَيَحۡلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحۡلِفُونَ لَكُمۡ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٍۚ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ

translations.saheeh: On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.
translations.pickthall: On the day when Allah will raise them all together, then will they swear unto Him as they (now) swear unto you, and they will fancy that they have some standing. Lo! is it not they who are the liars?
translations.khattab: On the Day Allah resurrects them all, they will ˹falsely˺ swear to Him as they swear to you, thinking they have something to stand on. Indeed, it is they who are the ˹total˺ liars
translations.arberry: Upon the day when God shall raise them up all together, and they will swear to Him, as they swear to you, and think they are on something. Surely, they are the liars!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوۡمࣰ ا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنۡ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنَهُمۡ أَوۡ عَشِيرَتَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحࣲ مِّنۡهُۖ وَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱللَّهِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

translations.saheeh: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allah. Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful.
translations.pickthall: Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's party who are the successful?
translations.khattab: You will never find a people who ˹truly˺ believe in Allah and the Last Day loyal to those who defy Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their parents, children, siblings, or extended family. For those ˹believers˺, Allah has instilled faith in their hearts and strengthened them with a spirit from Him. He will admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. They are the party of Allah. Indeed, Allah’s party is bound to succeed
translations.arberry: Thou shalt not find any people who believe in God and the Last Day who are loving to anyone who opposes. God and His Messenger, not though they were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their clan. Those -- He has written faith upon their hearts, and He has confirmed them with a Spirit from Himself; and He shall admit them into gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to dwell forever, God being well-pleased with them, and they well-pleased with Him. Those are God's party; why, surely God's party -- they are the prosperers.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَن تَنفَعَكُمۡ أَرۡحَامُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡۚ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
translations.pickthall: Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do.
translations.khattab: Neither your relatives nor children will benefit you on Judgment Day—He will decide between you ˹all˺. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do
translations.arberry: Neither your blood-kindred nor your children shall profit you upon the Day of Resurrection; He shall distinguish between you. And God sees the things you do.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِيهِمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

translations.saheeh: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
translations.pickthall: Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
translations.khattab: You certainly have an excellent example in them for whoever has hope in Allah and the Last Day. But whoever turns away, then surely Allah ˹alone˺ is the Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy
translations.arberry: You have had a good example in them for whoever hopes for God and the Last Day. And whosoever turns away, surely God is the All-sufficient, the All-laudable.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.
translations.khattab: O believers! When the call to prayer is made on Friday, then proceed ˹diligently˺ to the remembrance of Allah and leave off ˹your˺ business. That is best for you, if only you knew
translations.arberry: O believers, when proclamation is made for prayer on the Day of Congregation, hasten to God's remembrance and leave trafficking aside; that is better for you, did you but know.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحࣰ ا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

translations.saheeh: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
translations.pickthall: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph.
translations.khattab: ˹Consider˺ the Day He will gather you ˹all˺ for the Day of Gathering—that will be the Day of mutual loss and gain. So whoever believes in Allah and does good, He will absolve them of their sins and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. That is the ultimate triumph
translations.arberry: Upon the day when He shall gather you for the Day of Gathering; that shall be the Day of Mutual Fraud. And whosoever believes in God, and does righteousness, God will acquit him of his evil deeds, and admit him into gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to dwell for ever and ever; that is the mighty triumph.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡجَمۡعِۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِۗ وَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحࣰ ا يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

That is the great attainment.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفࣲ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلࣲ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out
translations.pickthall: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him,
translations.khattab: Then when they have ˹almost˺ reached the end of their waiting period, either retain them honourably or separate from them honourably. And call two of your reliable men to witness ˹either way˺—and ˹let the witnesses˺ bear true testimony for ˹the sake of˺ Allah. This is enjoined on whoever has faith in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them
translations.arberry: Then, when they have reached their term, retain them honourably, or part from them honourably. And call in to witness two men of equity from among yourselves; and perform the witnessing to God Himself. By this then is admonished whosoever believes in God and the Last Day. And whosoever fears God, He will appoint for him a way out,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعۡتَذِرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

translations.saheeh: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
translations.pickthall: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
translations.khattab: ˹The deniers will then be told,˺ “O disbelievers! Make no excuses this Day! You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”
translations.arberry: 'O you unbelievers, do not excuse yourselves today; you are only being recompensed for what you were doing.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةࣰ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: O believers! Turn to Allah in sincere repentance, so your Lord may absolve you of your sins and admit you into Gardens, under which rivers flow, on the Day Allah will not disgrace the Prophet or the believers with him. Their light will shine ahead of them and on their right. They will say, “Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. ˹For˺ You are truly Most Capable of everything.”
translations.arberry: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance; it may be that your Lord will acquit you of your evil deeds, and will admit you into gardens underneath which rivers flow. Upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who believe with him, their light running before them, and on their right hands; and they say, 'Our 'Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us; surely Thou art powerful over everything.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
translations.pickthall: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
translations.khattab: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”
translations.arberry: 'No needy man shall enter it today against your will.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
translations.pickthall: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
translations.khattab: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide
translations.arberry: Or have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection? Surely you shall have whatever you judge!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ

translations.saheeh: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
translations.pickthall: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
translations.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the leg shall be bared, and they shall be summoned to bow themselves, but they cannot;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
translations.khattab: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
translations.arberry: violent that He compelled against them seven nights and eight days, uninterruptedly, and thou mightest see the people laid prostrate in it as if they were the stumps of fallen down palm-trees.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ

translations.saheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
translations.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
translations.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”
translations.arberry: 'Eat and drink with wholesome appetite for that you did long ago, in the days gone by.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
translations.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
translations.khattab: So this Day they will have no close friend here
translations.arberry: therefore he today has not here one loyal friend,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
translations.pickthall: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
translations.khattab: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length
translations.arberry: To Him the angels and the Spirit mount up, in a day whereof the measure is fifty thousand years.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ

translations.saheeh: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
translations.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
translations.khattab: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass
translations.arberry: Upon the day when heaven shall be as molten copper

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
translations.pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
translations.khattab: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment
translations.arberry: who confirm the Day of Doom

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
translations.pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
translations.khattab: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—
translations.arberry: Then leave them alone to plunge and play until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ

translations.saheeh: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
translations.pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
translations.khattab: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺
translations.arberry: the day they shall come forth from the tombs hastily, as if they were hurrying unto a waymark,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
translations.pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
translations.khattab: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of
translations.arberry: humbled their eyes, overspreading them abasement. That is the day which they were promised.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبࣰ ا مَّهِيلًا

translations.saheeh: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
translations.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
translations.khattab: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand
translations.arberry: upon the day when the earth and the mountains shall quake and the mountains become a slipping heap of sand.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَكَيۡفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا يَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡوِلۡدَٰنَ شِيبًا

translations.saheeh: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
translations.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
translations.khattab: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey
translations.arberry: If therefore you disbelieve, how will you guard yourselves against a day that shall make the children grey-headed?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَوۡمٌ عَسِيرٌ

translations.saheeh: That Day will be a difficult day
translations.pickthall: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
translations.khattab: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—
translations.arberry: that day will be a harsh day,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
translations.pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
translations.khattab: and deny the Day of Judgment
translations.arberry: and we cried lies to the Day of Doom,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

translations.saheeh: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
translations.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
translations.khattab: I do swear by the Day of Judgment
translations.arberry: No! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ

translations.saheeh: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
translations.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
translations.khattab: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
translations.arberry: asking, 'When shall be the Day of Resurrection?'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمࣰ ا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
translations.pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
translations.khattab: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror
translations.arberry: They fulfil their vows, and fear a day whose evil is upon the wing;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسࣰ ا قَمۡطَرِيرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
translations.pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
translations.khattab: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
translations.arberry: for we fear from our Lord a frowning day, inauspicious.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةࣰ وَسُرُورࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
translations.pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
translations.khattab: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy
translations.arberry: So God has guarded them from the evil of that day, and has procured them radiancy and gladness,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا ثَقِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
translations.pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
translations.khattab: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them
translations.arberry: Surely these men love the hasty world, and leave be behind them a heavy day.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِأَيِّ يَوۡمٍ أُجِّلَتۡ

translations.saheeh: For what Day was it postponed?
translations.pickthall: For what day is the time appointed?
translations.khattab: for which Day has all this been set
translations.arberry: to what day shall they be delayed?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ

translations.saheeh: For the Day of Judgement.
translations.pickthall: For the Day of Decision.
translations.khattab: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision
translations.arberry: To the Day of Decision.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ

translations.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
translations.pickthall: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
translations.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is
translations.arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Decision?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: This is a Day they will not speak,
translations.pickthall: This is a day wherein they speak not,
translations.khattab: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak
translations.arberry: This is the day they shall not speak

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
translations.pickthall: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
translations.khattab: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺
translations.arberry: 'This is the Day of Decision; We have joined you with the ancients;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
translations.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
translations.khattab: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
translations.arberry: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
translations.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
translations.khattab: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
translations.arberry: the day the Trumpet is blown, and you shall come in troops,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
translations.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
translations.khattab: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks they shall speak not, save him to whom the All-merciful has given leave, and who speaks aright.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

translations.saheeh: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
translations.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
translations.khattab: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord
translations.arberry: That is the true day; so whosoever wills takes unto his Lord a resort.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
translations.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
translations.khattab: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
translations.arberry: Lo, We have warned you of a nigh chastisement, upon the day when a man shall behold what his hands have forwarded, and the unbeliever shall say, 'O would that I were dust!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ

translations.saheeh: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
translations.pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
translations.khattab: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the first blast shivers

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

translations.saheeh: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
translations.pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
translations.khattab: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving
translations.arberry: upon the day when man shall remember what he has striven,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا

translations.saheeh: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
translations.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
translations.khattab: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning
translations.arberry: It shall be as if; on the day they see it, they have but tarried for an evening, or its forenoon.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ

translations.saheeh: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
translations.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
translations.khattab: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings
translations.arberry: upon the day when a man shall flee from his brother,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
translations.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
translations.khattab: burning in it on Judgment Day
translations.arberry: roasting therein on the Day of Doom,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
translations.khattab: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is
translations.arberry: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
translations.khattab: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is
translations.arberry: Again, what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسࣱ لِّنَفۡسࣲ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلَّهِ

translations.saheeh: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
translations.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺
translations.arberry: A day when no soul shall possess aught to succour another soul; that day the Command shall belong unto God.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: For a tremendous Day -
translations.pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,
translations.khattab: for a tremendous Day—
translations.arberry: unto a mighty day

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
translations.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.khattab: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: a day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all Being?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.saheeh: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
translations.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
translations.khattab: those who deny Judgment Day
translations.arberry: who cry lies to the Day of Doom;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ

translations.saheeh: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
translations.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
translations.khattab: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
translations.arberry: So today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ

translations.saheeh: And [by] the promised Day
translations.pickthall: And by the Promised Day.
translations.khattab: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺
translations.arberry: by the promised day,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

translations.saheeh: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
translations.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
translations.khattab: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed
translations.arberry: upon the day when the secrets are tried,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمࣱ فِي يَوۡمࣲ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
translations.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
translations.khattab: or to give food in times of famine
translations.arberry: or giving food upon a day of hunger

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ

translations.saheeh: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
translations.pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths
translations.arberry: The day that men shall be like scattered moths,
